chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Muhammad ibn Qaza'a, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): 'The ones in front of us are saying that Ibrahim (peace be upon him) circumcised himself with a curved knife upon a large jar.' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'Glory be to Allah! It is not as what they are saying. They are lying upon Ibrahim (peace be upon him).' I said: 'And how is that?'

So he (peace be upon him) said: 'The Prophets (peace be upon them), their wrapping used to drop off from them along with their navel during the seventh day. So when (Ismail) was born to Ibrahim (peace be upon him) from Hajar, Sarah reproached Hajar with what slaves are reproached with. So Hajar cried, and that was grievous upon her. So when Ismail saw her crying, he cried as well due to her crying, and Ibrahim (peace be upon him) entered. So he said:

So Ibrahim stood upon his Prayer Mat, so he whispered unto his Lord, and asked Him to Cast that away from Hajar. So Allah Cast that off from Hajar. So when Sarah gave birth to Is'haq, and it was the seventh day, there fell down from him, his navel, but his wrapping did not fall. So Sarah panicked from that.

So when Ibrahim (peace be upon him) came over to her, she said: 'O Ibrahim! What is this occurrence which has occurred in the Progeny of Ibrahim, and the children of the Prophets? This is your son Is'haq. His navel has fallen off from him and his wrapping did not fall off from him.' So Ibrahim (peace be upon him) stood upon his Prayer Mat, so he whispered to his Lord, and said: 'O Lord! What is this occurrence which has occurred in the Progeny of Ibrahim and the children of the Prophets, and this is my son Is'haq. His navel has fallen off from him and his wrapping did not fall off from him.'

So Allah the High Revealed unto him: 'O Ibrahim! This is due to what Sarah reproached Hajar with, so I Swore that, that would not fall off from anyone from the children of the Prophets due to the reproach of Sarah to Hajar. Therefore, circumcise Is'haq with the iron, and make him taste the heat of the iron'.
He said: 'So Ibrahim (peace be upon him) circumcised him with the iron, and the Sunnah flowed with the circumcision in the children of Is'haq after that'.
ai.seo_question: Why did Prophet Ibrahim circumcise his son with iron instead of himself?
ai.summary: This narration from *Al-Kafi* (Chapter 23) refutes the prevalent view that Prophet Ibrahim circumcised himself, asserting instead that he circumcised his son Is'haq with iron due to a divine decree triggered by Sarah's reproach of Hajar. It highlights a unique theological nuance in Shia tradition where the natural shedding of the foreskin (*ghurfah*) among prophets was altered to a manual procedure, establishing the enduring Sunnah of circumcision for the progeny of Is'haq.
